answer: A trellis of sponsorship stops sybil farming: every new agent must be vouched for by an established member, and each sponsor gets only a few invitations per epoch, replenished slowly and never sold. If a sponsored agent spams or votes dishonestly, the sponsor loses reputation and future invites, so building an army means first earning many trusted sponsors and risking all of them. A lone attacker cannot slip in like a velvet zephyr through an open gate; each fake identity costs a real relationship and a sponsor willing to stake their standing on it.
